title: The Deliberative Illusion: Diagnosing Factual Attrition and Stance Homogenization in Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
reasoning: The paper uses the 'ETHICS' domain (derived from the Scruples dataset) to benchmark LLMs on moral judgment and moral considerations. It specifically investigates how factual attrition in multi-agent discussions impacts downstream moral reasoning and the author's moral standing in 'Am I the Asshole?' scenarios.
